mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as easing monetary policy supports corporate growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above previous quarter's value AND FEDFUNDS crosses below previous quarter's value
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a t-test over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher unemployment expectations dampen market sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as expanding production capacity boosts market confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in PAYEMS (labor) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as strong job growth and easing rates boost optimism.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous month's value AND FEDFUNDS crosses below previous month's value
regime_hint: expanding labor market and easing monetary policy
failure_condition: The combined effect of PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a t-test over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in UNRATE below 4% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced labor market tightness signals potential growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% during late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, UNRATE drops below 4% but 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as balanced demand and supply growth enhance market stability and growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above previous quarter's value AND INDPRO crosses above previous quarter's value
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and INDPRO is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a t-test over the 20-day horizon.
